question: Sounds of single frequency and mixture of several frequencies are known as ______________, respectively.
solution:
The correct answer is __**tone and note**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• A **tone** is defined as a sound that consists of a **single frequency**. It is often referred to as a "pure" sound because it lacks the complexity of multiple overlapping waves.
 
• A **note** is a sound produced by a **mixture of several frequencies**. When multiple tones are combined, they create a note, which is typically what we perceive when listening to musical instruments.
 
• In the context of music, a **note** is often more pleasant to the ear than a single tone because of its rich **harmonic content** and complexity.
